title: Practice 9: Numerals, nouns and adjectives together

blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.q: Все млекопитающие имеют семь ___ (шейные позвонки).
exercises.prompt: All mammals have seven cervical vertebrae.
exercises.why: «If the number ends in 2, 3 or 4 use the genitive singular … If the number ends in 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 0 or -надцать use the genitive plural.» Много, мало, сколько, несколько also take the genitive. — Wikibooks, «Genitive case».
